title: GDPR & EU Rights
subtitle: VIBED respects your privacy and complies strictly with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Here is how you can exercise your EU data rights.

rights.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you possess specific fundamental rights regarding your personal data:

items.title: Right to Access
items.text: You can request a complete copy of the personal data we hold about you.

items.title: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
items.text: You can ask us to delete all your personal data, project files, and account information permanently.

items.title: Right to Rectification
items.text: You have the right to request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal data.

items.title: Right to Object & Restrict Processing
items.text: You can object to our processing of your data, including processing for direct marketing or analytics.

exercise.p1: To exercise any of these rights, simply email us from the address associated with your VIBED account. We process all Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) within 30 days, entirely free of charge.
